```{python}
#| label: puente
nvd_cwe = dict(zip(cves.cve, cves.cwes.fillna("")))
k2 = kev.copy()
k2["cwe_all"] = [
    (str(r.cwes) if pd.notna(r.cwes) else "") or nvd_cwe.get(r.cve, "")
    for r in k2.itertuples()
]
ex = k2.assign(cwe=k2.cwe_all.str.split(";")).explode("cwe")
ex = ex[ex.cwe.astype(str).str.startswith("CWE-")]
mapped = ex.merge(brid, on="cwe", how="inner")

print(L["attack_puente"].format(n=mapped.cve.nunique(), tot=len(kev),
                                p=mapped.cve.nunique() / len(kev) * 100))
print(L["attack_tecn"].format(n=mapped.technique.nunique()))
```

```{python}
#| label: g-attack
top = (mapped.groupby(["technique", "technique_name"]).cve.nunique()
       .sort_values(ascending=False).head(12).reset_index())
top["etiqueta"] = top.technique + " · " + top.technique_name.str.slice(0, 26)

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    y=top.etiqueta, x=top.cve, orientation="h",
    marker=dict(color=top.cve, colorscale=[[0, "#1f6feb"], [1, WARN]]),
    text=top.cve, textposition="outside", textfont_color="#e6edf3"))
fig.update_layout(height=470, xaxis_title=L["attack_eje"], yaxis_title="",
                  yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"), showlegend=False,
                  margin=dict(l=250, r=50))
fig.show()
```
